summary: StudentProfileDetails is a user control for managing and displaying student profile details, including their responses, numbering codes, headings, and privacy information. It provides add, edit, delete, and data binding workflows, supports both editable and non-editable screens, and handles displaying empty data scenarios as well as row-level actions. The control uses UI elements such as GridView, FormView, Panels, Labels, Buttons, and DropDownLists, and relies on session information and data source integration.
purpose: To allow users (likely administrative staff) to view, add, edit, or delete detailed student profile entries, including web page responses and structured numbering. The system provides granular control of UI visibility and handles special cases like empty data and privacy labeling.

workflows.name: Add Student Profile Detail
steps: Provide dropdowns for headings and numbering codes.
User enters response and sort order.
On save, StudentID is set, StudentDetail is added.

workflows.name: Edit Student Profile Detail
steps: Bind FormView with StudentDetail from selected row.

workflows.name: Delete Student Profile Detail
steps: On delete command, create StudentDetail with ID.
Rebind GridView and redirect as needed.

workflows.name: Display Student Profile Details
steps: If data is empty and screen is editable, show empty data panel and add button.
Handle row-level visibility for headers and responses.
Format response as hyperlink if it is a web page.

business_rules: Do not repeat header on subsequent rows for the same header.
WebPage entries use hyperlinks for responses.
Numbering characters are formatted and indented according to NumberingIndentLevel.
Empty data panel only shown if there are no rows and screen is editable.
Only allow add/edit/delete if ScreenIsEditable is true.
validations: Validate session before selecting profile data source.
Response, HeadingID, NumberingCodeID, and SortOrder fields validated upon save.
CommandName checked for valid operations (cmdSave, cmdEdit, cmdAdd, cmdDelete, cmdCancel).
calculations: SortOrder defaults to -1 if not provided.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable controls visibility of row cells and add/edit/delete buttons.
If UserSession is null, data selection is canceled.
Show details for FormView only on certain commands.
system_behavior: Hide details and rebind profile view as needed.
dependencies: Grid utility methods for UI setup.
exceptions: Event validation JavaScript errors prevented use of EmptyDataTemplate; handled by showing empty data panel instead.
content_gaps: No explicit error handling for database/data layer failures documented.
Details about UI layout and user navigation are inferred but not fully specified.
Field-level validation details (e.g., regex, max length) are not present.
